image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a meal setting. In the foreground, a slice of meatloaf sits on a white plate with blue decorative patterns. The meatloaf slice shows a browned crust and a textured interior. Behind it, a hand holds a knife near a rectangular casserole dish containing mashed potatoes. A fork rests on the right side. The background includes a patterned tablecloth.
